question: Can an adaptive memory correct the model currently in use? The leaf-neighbour candidate helped the incumbent tree, but blending its full probabilities back into a stronger pair did not qualify. Here the correction is learned against out-of-fold probabilities of each particular reference, including the established stronger pair.
data: Same bound 4,061-row fitting partition. Recreate the exact four stratified group-fold identities from the stored teacher receipts. Reuse both original-tree and table-foundation held-out probabilities. Fit one additional aligned field tree per matching fold and predict its held-out rows. Neither the support outcomes nor the query outcome participated in the teacher fitting for that shared fold.
model: Two independent small supervised distance models, one per frozen base. The prior for each target is its out-of-fold positive probability. A query-conditioned embedding assigns scores to feature matches plus exact recurring and varying blocks discovered on train. From same-fold reference outcomes subtract their own held-out base predictions, smooth those residuals using learned similarities over up to the nearest 64 thresholds with ties, and allow a bounded probability correction with effective-sample shrinkage. Exclude identical feature groups in every training query. At inference equal-average the corrections from the four training memory banks and add them to the full-training reference probability; only training rows supply memory. Use 22 epochs, query batches of 64, and 384 sampled references per training batch. No names, row positions or downstream labels as model inputs.
test: Primary is direct adjustment of the aligned-tree plus TabICL pair. On the 808-row nomination let the common election choose retention or a correction share. Require no loss on either later 817- or 807-row check and a pooled lift of 0.003 to proceed. The separately trained correction to the teammate's single tree is descriptive, with no automatic qualification. Four additional classifier fits, two lightweight supervised correction fits, zero new foundation contexts or API calls. Save components for reuse.
